Hildegard 0.1.16 is a pre-alpha. It adds a server install profile, a primary device, and Talk polish.

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Server (speech, always on):** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh -s -- --server`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Desktop app:** pick your system's download below, or from [dbaney.com/hildegard](https://dbaney.com/hildegard/).

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## New

- **A server install profile.** `hildegard install --yes --server` (or `install.sh --server` through the one-line
  install) sets up a computer that runs Hildegard for your other devices: speech, and a user systemd service on
  Linux or a LaunchAgent on macOS that starts it at login. The 0.1.15 release predates this profile, so the one-line
  `--server` install needs 0.1.16.
- **A primary device.** Pick the device where Talk hears, answers and speaks by default: `hildegard choir primary
  <device|local>`, or Make primary in Settings › Devices. It is separate from the device that renders. Removing the
  device puts it back to this computer.
- **Talk polish.** Each Talk turn now shows how long listening, thinking and speaking took, as a three-part meter.
  Talk starts on your primary device, and Settings › Devices lists what each device can do, this computer included.
